issues.problem: The instructions say to use π = 22/7 only when r = 7 cm and the π button for all other questions. The exemplar's check for r = 14 cm uses 22/7 and gives 205.33 cm². With the π button the value is about 205.25 cm² (≈ 4 × 51.31). The check should use the π button, or the instructions should allow 22/7 here.

Lesson 5 already teaches the segment formula and the ½r²sinθ triangle formula. Lesson 6 says its DQB questions point toward segments 'in Lesson 7', and Lesson 7 presents segments as a fresh investigation. The sequence of when segments are introduced is inconsistent.
